thoughts.summary: Budget record one preserves an independently useful decision with enough concrete detail to represent a realistic memory entry. It explains the chosen behavior, its boundary, the reason it exists, and the observable consequence for later work. The wording remains intentionally specific so the entry is useful when recalled, while the benchmark can prove that several individually valid memories are still omitted once their combined context would exceed the approved prompt budget.
